data.description: A New Standard of Luxury | Exclusive Residences with Panoramic City Views
data.display_address: vela_dorchester_collection, The Vela Dorchester Collection, Business Bay, Dubai
data.long_description:
Vela Dorchester Collection, an architectural marvel in Business Bay, offers an ultra-luxurious living experience that combines cutting-edge design and modern elegance. Designed by the renowned Foster + Partners, this 30-storey tower features a mix of Sky Residences, Marina Residences, 4-bedroom penthouses, and an exclusive 5-bedroom Sky Palace.

The residences are meticulously crafted with spacious, light-filled layouts that are enhanced by panoramic windows, offering stunning views of the waterfront and Dubai’s iconic skyline. The development also boasts a range of world-class amenities, including a state-of-the-art fitness center, infinity pool with panoramic city views, a relaxing spa, a dedicated children’s playroom, and even a cinema for private screenings.

Residents can also benefit from the building’s conference rooms, concierge services, and round-the-clock security. Perfectly situated on the Marasi Bay waterfront, Vela Dorchester Collection provides direct access to the city’s key destinations. Within 5 minutes, residents can reach the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, while Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, Marina Mall, and JBR beach are only 20 minutes away, making it an ideal home for those who value both comfort and connectivity.
